experiment: Phase 7E Background Loss Calibration and Formulation

variants.name: Variant A: Control (Phase 7D Batch-Pooled L1)
variants.description: Reproduction of Phase 7D masked L1 with batch-pooled denominator and default initialization.

variants.name: Variant B: Audited Per-Patch Normalization
variants.description: Each patch normalized individually by its positive mask volume; equal weighting across density.

variants.name: Variant D1: Calibrated Logit Bias (-4.0)
variants.description: Final layer bias initialized to -4.0 (output floor ~0.018); neutral unannotated voxels remain neutral.

variants.name: Variant D2: Zero-Offset Target Rescaling
variants.description: Target Gaussian smoothly scaled to reach 0.0 at r_pos=2.5 um; eliminates boundary discontinuity.
